entries.27c2bdb74cb1609c: A pioneer manufacturer that launched an air ejector vacuum generator under the CONVUM trademark in 1972, it continues research and development focused on vacuum suction equipment. It develops all of its products in-house and, in response to the spread of industrial and collaborative robots, is expanding its lineup of robot suction hands and developing suction pads with new materials and shapes.
entries.2c90828b4ab63636: The company is headquartered in Shimomaruko, Ota-ku, Tokyo. Founded in 1951 as Myotoku Seisakusho Co., Ltd., a precision machine parts processing company, it changed its trade name to CONVUM Ltd. in 2022. As of December 31, 2025, it had 91 employees and, together with two consolidated subsidiaries, formed a group. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
